Pose - Reading a File.description:
🕴️ Pose: Reading a File
Looking down at a document or data pad — engaged in information, studious or analytical.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Reading a File.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, angle the head and gaze slightly downward with both hands held near mid-chest in a reading posture. Show a file, folder, clipboard, or tablet only when another selected visual trait explicitly defines that prop; otherwise keep the hands empty and close together. Female: shoulders round forward slightly as the head drops. Male: shoulders stay square as the head drops. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own reading posture.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
